# Polar Coordinates with plotnine

This book collects examples of `coord_polar()` for
[plotnine](https://plotnine.org), the Python grammar of graphics library.

The examples serve as targets for development and as a reference for users.
They are drawn from two sources:

- The [ggplot2 book](https://ggplot2-book.org/coord.html#polar-coordinates-with-coord_polar),
  which documents `coord_polar()` in R's ggplot2.
- The [socviz](https://socviz.co) package, which provides real-world datasets
  used in data-visualisation teaching.

The source is at <https://github.com/iangow/coord-polar-test>.
